title: StudyNotion
description: A full-stack learning management system built on the MERN stack, with JWT-based authentication, Razorpay payment integration, and a dynamic video progress tracking system.

title: RAG Pipeline for Video Analysis
description: A local retrieval-augmented generation pipeline that pulls football reaction and analysis videos via yt-dlp and transcribes pundit commentary with OpenAI's Whisper large-v2.

title: Agentic AI Compiler Assistant
description: A CLI tool that intercepts compiler errors and uses LLMs to suggest and apply automated code fixes in real-time.
